paragraphs.source_en: Or have you only comfort, and the lust for comfort, that stealthy thing that enters the house a guest, and then becomes a host, and then a master?

units.source_en: Or have you only comfort, and the lust for comfort, that stealthy thing that enters the house a guest, and then becomes a host, and then a master?

ja.t: それともあなたがたには、

paragraphs.source_en: Ay, and it becomes a tamer, and with hook and scourge makes puppets of your larger desires.

units.source_en: Ay, and it becomes a tamer, and with hook and scourge makes puppets of your larger desires.

ja.t: とで、あなたがたのより

paragraphs.source_en: It lulls you to sleep only to stand by your bed and jeer at the dignity of the flesh.

units.source_en: It lulls you to sleep only to stand by your bed and jeer at the dignity of the flesh.

paragraphs.source_en: It makes mock of your sound senses, and lays them in thistledown like fragile vessels.

units.source_en: It makes mock of your sound senses, and lays them in thistledown like fragile vessels.

ja.t: のように、それらをあざみの

paragraphs.source_en: Verily the lust for comfort murders the passion of the soul, and then walks grinning in the funeral.

units.source_en: Verily the lust for comfort murders the passion of the soul, and then walks grinning in the funeral.

paragraphs.source_en: But you, children of space, you restless in rest, you shall not be trapped nor tamed.

units.source_en: But you, children of space, you restless in rest, you shall not be trapped nor tamed.

ja.t: いならされることもない。

paragraphs.source_en: It shall not be a glistening film that covers a wound, but an eyelid that guards the eye.

units.source_en: It shall not be a glistening film that covers a wound, but an eyelid that guards the eye.

ja.t: るまぶたであるべきだ。

paragraphs.source_en: You shall not fold your wings that you may pass through doors, nor bend your heads that they strike not against a ceiling, nor fear to breathe lest walls should crack and fall down.

units.source_en: You shall not fold your wings that you may pass through doors, nor bend your heads that they strike not against a ceiling, nor fear to breathe lest walls should crack and fall down.

ja.t: をひそめることもない。

paragraphs.source_en: And though of magnificence and splendour, your house shall not hold your secret nor shelter your longing.

units.source_en: And though of magnificence and splendour, your house shall not hold your secret nor shelter your longing.

ja.t: やかであっても、あなたがたの
じこめず、あなたがたの
れをかくまうこともない。

paragraphs.source_en: For that which is boundless in you abides in the mansion of the sky, whose door is the morning mist, and whose windows are the songs and the silences of night.

units.source_en: For that which is boundless in you abides in the mansion of the sky, whose door is the morning mist, and whose windows are the songs and the silences of night.

ja.t: なぜなら、あなたがたの

paragraphs.source_en: And though you seek in garments the freedom of privacy you may find in them a harness and a chain.

units.source_en: And though you seek in garments the freedom of privacy you may find in them a harness and a chain.

ja.t: めても、あなたがたはそこに

paragraphs.source_en: Would that you could meet the sun and the wind with more of your skin and less of your raiment,

units.source_en: Would that you could meet the sun and the wind with more of your skin and less of your raiment,

ja.t: できることなら、あなたがたは

paragraphs.source_en: And when his work was done he laughed in the forest. Forget not that modesty is for a shield against the eye of the unclean.

units.source_en: And when his work was done he laughed in the forest.
Forget not that modesty is for a shield against the eye of the unclean.

paragraphs.source_en: And when the unclean shall be no more, what were modesty but a fetter and a fouling of the mind?

units.source_en: And when the unclean shall be no more, what were modesty but a fetter and a fouling of the mind?

ja.t: なものがもはやなくなるとき、

paragraphs.source_en: And forget not that the earth delights to feel your bare feet and the winds long to play with your hair.

units.source_en: And forget not that the earth delights to feel your bare feet and the winds long to play with your hair.

paragraphs.source_en: To you the earth yields her fruit, and you shall not want if you but know how to fill your hands.

units.source_en: To you the earth yields her fruit, and you shall not want if you but know how to fill your hands.
